## Summary
- Describe what changed and why in both high-level and technical terms.
- Link impacted modules, services, or infrastructure components.
- Reference the Essential principles touched (see `en/docs/principles-essential.md`).

## Checklist
- [ ] Essential principles referenced and respected
- [ ] Tests added or updated with evidence attached
- [ ] Observability signals (logs/metrics/traces) reviewed or created
- [ ] Security implications evaluated (secrets, dependencies, access)
- [ ] Documentation touched (recipes, onboarding, glossary, changelog)
- [ ] Stakeholders notified (mentors, product/support, operations)
